summary: SF_CAULK_EXT_v1 draft artifacts pass all critical checks and present 3 major issues requiring correction before assembly. This is a structurally novel spec -- standalone LF-based caulking line item, no quality tier, no substrate state, no application method dimension. 11 tasks (all binary) across 5 modules thread correctly between sop_modules.json and production.json with 1:1 task ID coverage and UOM alignment. Silicone correctly excluded (COMPAT-CAULK-001). Polyurethane 3-7 day cure gate documented with XSPEC_CAULK_POLY_CURE_GATE flag. Backer rod conditional on joint_complexity correctly wired. Sequencing rule (after primer, before finish) documented with XSPEC_CAULK_COMPLETE flag. LF is primary UOM throughout. Three-sided adhesion prevention documented in research, materials (COMPAT-CAULK-005), and SOP (backer rod quality_notes). No quality tier -- sealant_type replaces QT as cost/quality driver. 2 protection zones (ext_ground_cover, ext_surface_adjacent) with setup/teardown tasks properly paired. 3 major issues: (1) material system IDs in materials.json deviate from resolution.json proposed IDs, (2) product_role 'sealant' used in materials.json is not in resolution.json applicable_enums, (3) consumable_category 'fill_material' is not a standard system convention value. 2 minor issues. 0 blockers.

issues.description: Material system IDs in materials.json deviate from resolution.json proposed IDs. Resolution proposes SYS_CAULK_ACRYLIC_LATEX, SYS_CAULK_SILICONIZED_ACRYLIC, SYS_CAULK_POLYURETHANE, SYS_CAULK_HYBRID_MS. Materials.json uses SYS_EXT_CAULK_ACRYLIC, SYS_EXT_CAULK_SILICONIZED, SYS_EXT_CAULK_POLYURETHANE, SYS_EXT_CAULK_HYBRID. The naming pattern is inconsistent -- Materials Manager inserted 'EXT' infix and shortened sealant type suffixes. Either convention is defensible (EXT infix follows exterior siding patterns), but the mismatch between resolver output and downstream artifact breaks the threading contract.
issues.suggested_fix: Align on one naming convention. Recommended: adopt materials.json SYS_EXT_CAULK_* pattern (consistent with sibling exterior specs SYS_EXT_*) and update resolution.json registry_additions_proposed to match. Alternatively, update materials.json to match resolver's SYS_CAULK_* pattern. Either way, both files must agree.

issues.description: materials.json declares product_role: 'sealant' on all 4 material systems. Resolution.json applicable_enums.product_role lists only ['specialty'] as the valid value for this spec. 'sealant' is not an existing controlled enum value in the product_role enum. The Materials Manager introduced a new enum value without going through the resolver.
issues.suggested_fix: Either (a) change product_role to 'specialty' in materials.json per resolution.json, or (b) add 'sealant' to controlled_enums.json product_role values and update resolution.json applicable_enums. Option (b) is preferable -- 'sealant' is a more descriptive product_role than 'specialty' and may be reused by future sealant specs. Requires registry update.

issues.description: consumable_category 'fill_material' is used for CON_CAULK_TUBE and CON_CAULK_BACKER_ROD in both research.json and materials.json. The system convention defines consumable_category values as: applicator, protection, abrasive, tool, prep. 'fill_material' is not a standard value. Resolution.json applicable_enums.consumable_category lists ['fill_material', 'protection', 'tool'] -- the resolver appears to have accepted a non-standard value from research without flagging it.
issues.suggested_fix: Either (a) map sealant tubes and backer rod to an existing category ('prep' is closest -- sealant is a prep-phase consumable in the painting workflow context), or (b) formally add 'fill_material' to controlled_enums.json consumable_category values with justification that sealant/backer rod are genuinely a new category distinct from applicator/protection/abrasive/tool/prep. Option (b) is recommended -- sealant tubes are fundamentally different from any existing category.

issues.description: Site condition rules (dew_point_risk) are present on TSK_CAULK_JOINT_CLEAN, TSK_CAULK_APPLY_SIMPLE, and TSK_CAULK_APPLY_BACKER but NOT on TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD. Backer rod installation does not require dry conditions in the same way sealant application does (backer rod is a mechanical fit, not a chemical bond), so this omission is technically correct. However, wind_condition and surface_temperature rules are absent entirely from all tasks. Per EXT-4 doctrine check, exterior specs should declare surface_temperature and wind rules. Caulking is less wind-sensitive than spray painting, and sealant application is temperature-dependent (most sealants require >40F surface temp), but no rules enforce this.
issues.suggested_fix: Add surface_temperature rule (exclude_when surface_temp < 40F) to apply tasks. Wind condition rules are genuinely not needed for caulking (not a spray operation). Document the wind exclusion rationale in assumptions.

issues.description: Coverage profile COV_CAULK_SEALANT references system IDs (SYS_EXT_CAULK_ACRYLIC, etc.) in its coverage_by_system block. These are internally consistent within materials.json but use the deviated IDs noted in QA-001. If QA-001 is resolved by changing system IDs, coverage_by_system keys must also be updated.
issues.suggested_fix: Resolve as part of QA-001 system ID alignment.

doctrine_checks.details: All 11 task IDs in sop_modules.json task_id_manifest match production.json task_id_manifest exactly. No orphaned tasks in either file. Tasks: TSK_CAULK_PROTECT_GROUND, TSK_CAULK_MASK_ADJACENT, TSK_CAULK_STAGE_MATERIALS, TSK_CAULK_JOINT_CLEAN, TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD, TSK_CAULK_APPLY_SIMPLE, TSK_CAULK_APPLY_BACKER, TSK_CAULK_INSPECT, TSK_CAULK_ADHESION_CHECK, TSK_CAULK_TAPE_REMOVE, TSK_CAULK_CLEANUP. All use TSK_CAULK_ prefix per resolution.json task_prefix.

All 11 tasks are binary in both sop_modules.json and production.json. This is correct -- no quality tier dimension means no qt_conditional or qt_scaled tasks. sop_modules.json task_summary confirms: binary=11, qt_conditional=0, qt_scaled=0.

All task UOMs match between sop_modules.json and production.json. LF tasks (9): TSK_CAULK_PROTECT_GROUND, TSK_CAULK_MASK_ADJACENT, TSK_CAULK_JOINT_CLEAN, TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD, TSK_CAULK_APPLY_SIMPLE, TSK_CAULK_APPLY_BACKER, TSK_CAULK_INSPECT, TSK_CAULK_ADHESION_CHECK, TSK_CAULK_TAPE_REMOVE. FIXED tasks (2): TSK_CAULK_STAGE_MATERIALS, TSK_CAULK_CLEANUP. production.json cross_file_threading_check confirms alignment.

All 5 module IDs use MOD_CAULK_ prefix per resolution.json: MOD_CAULK_SETUP (3 tasks), MOD_CAULK_PREP (2 tasks), MOD_CAULK_APPLY (2 tasks), MOD_CAULK_INSPECT (2 tasks), MOD_CAULK_CLEANUP (2 tasks). Total: 11 tasks. Matches resolution.json module_prefix.expected_modules.

doctrine_checks.check: CROSS-FILE: Material System IDs in SOP
doctrine_checks.details: sop_modules.json does not directly reference SYS_ material system IDs (caulking SOP references sealant_type enum values in applies_when conditions, not SYS_ IDs). Material system selection happens at estimation time via IN_ENUM_CAULK_SEALANT_TYPE input. No threading mismatch risk within SOP, but QA-001 system ID mismatch between resolution.json and materials.json remains open.

production.json declares 1 factor modifier: FAC_CAULK_JOINT_COMPLEXITY. Uses FAC_CAULK_ prefix per convention (not FAC_EXT_CAULK_ -- caulking has no shared exterior modifiers like FAC_EXT_ACCESS per KD-012). Mechanism is task_selection (not rate_multiplier) -- controls which tasks are active based on joint_complexity dimension. No stacking interaction documented (correct -- single modifier, no stacking possible).

Module phase order: setup -> prep -> apply -> finish -> cleanup. Matches resolution.json applicable_enums.phase allowed values for this spec (no prime or interstage phases). sop_modules.json round_configurations confirm correct module sequencing for both RC_CAULK_SIMPLE and RC_CAULK_BACKER_ROD.

Confirmed across all files: research.json KD-003 documents no-QT decision. Resolution.json applicable_enums notes all tasks are binary. materials.json material_notes.no_quality_tier confirms. production.json quality_tier_effects.tiers = 'none'. No qt_rates, no qt_conditional tasks, no qt_scaled tasks anywhere.

No substrate_state configuration dimension. Caulking applies to joints between surfaces regardless of substrate state. No SS_* IDs referenced anywhere. Research excludes repaint scope (EXCL_CAULK_OLD_REMOVAL). This is structurally correct -- caulk joints have no substrate state concept analogous to painted surfaces.

Silicone explicitly excluded in: research.json RF-009 (finding), KD-006 (decision), EXCL_CAULK_SILICONE (exclusion). materials.json COMPAT-CAULK-001 (hard stop rule). sop_modules.json EXCL_SOP_SILICONE. sealant_type enum has 4 values -- none are silicone. Comprehensive exclusion across all artifacts.

Polyurethane 3-7 day cure gate documented in: research.json KD-007 and GATE_CAULK_POLY_CURE. materials.json SYS_EXT_CAULK_POLYURETHANE.scheduling_gate, COMPAT-CAULK-002, RISK-CAULK-001. sop_modules.json scheduling_gates GATE_CAULK_POLY_CURE with xspec_flag XSPEC_CAULK_POLY_CURE_GATE. production.json scheduling_effects.polyurethane_cure_gate. Consistently documented as absolute gate with no exceptions.

doctrine_checks.check: ARCH-5: Backer Rod Conditional on joint_complexity
doctrine_checks.details: Backer rod correctly gated by joint_complexity = backer_rod in: research.json KD-005, KD-008 (auto-escalate at 3/8 inch). sop_modules.json TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD applies_when joint_complexity=backer_rod. production.json TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD applies_when joint_complexity=backer_rod, uses IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD input. Round configs RC_CAULK_SIMPLE excludes backer rod tasks, RC_CAULK_BACKER_ROD includes them.

doctrine_checks.check: ARCH-6: Sequencing Rule (After Primer, Before Finish)
doctrine_checks.details: Sequencing documented in: research.json RF-005, KD-010, GATE_CAULK_AFTER_PRIMER, XSPEC_CAULK_SEQUENCE. sop_modules.json scheduling_gates GATE_CAULK_AFTER_PRIMER with xspec_flag XSPEC_CAULK_COMPLETE, cross_spec_dependencies XSPEC_CAULK_SEQUENCE listing 5 related painting specs. production.json scheduling_effects.sequencing_rule.

LF is primary UOM throughout: research.json KD-002 (LF decision). 9 of 11 tasks use LF. 2 tasks use FIXED (material staging 10 min, cleanup 15 min). Item ITM_CAULK_JOINT measured in LF. All production rates in LF/hr (or fixed_time_minutes for FIXED tasks). Inputs IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL and IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD both LF.

Three-sided adhesion prevention documented in: research.json RF-004 (finding), KD-009 (decision -- non-negotiable quality standard). materials.json COMPAT-CAULK-005 (prohibited on all joints). sop_modules.json TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD quality_notes (rod serves as bond-breaker). production.json TSK_CAULK_BACKER_ROD defect_tolerance (rod prevents bottom bond). Comprehensive coverage.

All 3 PaintScope key references use PS_EXT_* namespace: PS_EXT_SURFACE_LF.CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL, PS_EXT_SURFACE_LF.CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD, PS_EXT_META.ENUM.CAULK_SEALANT_TYPE. No interior PS_INT_* or bare PS_ keys. Consistent across resolution.json, sop_modules.json, and production.json.
No substrate states referenced -- spec has no substrate_state dimension (ARCH-2). No SS_EXT_* or SS_INT_* IDs appear. This is correct for a caulking spec -- joints have no painted state concept.

Both protection zones use ext_* prefix: ext_ground_cover, ext_surface_adjacent. Both are proposed new zones per resolution.json. No interior zone IDs. Setup tasks (TSK_CAULK_PROTECT_GROUND, TSK_CAULK_MASK_ADJACENT) reference correct zones. Teardown tasks (TSK_CAULK_CLEANUP, TSK_CAULK_TAPE_REMOVE) reference matching zones. sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones lists both with setup/teardown task pairings.

dew_point_risk rules present on apply tasks (TSK_CAULK_APPLY_SIMPLE, TSK_CAULK_APPLY_BACKER) and prep task (TSK_CAULK_JOINT_CLEAN). wind_condition rules absent -- acceptable because caulking is not a spray operation. surface_temperature rules absent -- see QA-004 (minor). Most sealants require >40F surface temperature per materials.json environmental_requirements, but no task-level rule enforces this.

FAC_EXT_ACCESS is intentionally excluded per KD-012 (access shared with painting spec, double-counting prevention). FAC_EXT_SUBSTRATE_CONDITION not applicable (no substrate conditioning for caulk joints). FAC_EXT_WIND not applicable (not a spray operation). The only factor modifier is FAC_CAULK_JOINT_COMPLEXITY (task_selection mechanism). This is a valid departure from standard exterior factor set -- caulking is a fundamentally different operation from painting.

FAC_CAULK_JOINT_COMPLEXITY uses task_selection mechanism (not rate multiplier), so division formula and stacking cap checks are not applicable. Each task variant has its own calibrated base rate -- no modifier multiplication occurs. Simple_bead and backer_rod both have modifier=1.00 (passthrough). No stacking possible with single selection factor.

No substrate state compatibility needed -- caulking has no substrate_state dimension. Sealant type selection is driven by joint movement class (low/medium/high), not substrate state. materials.json applies_when uses sealant_type and joint_movement, not SS_EXT_* states. This is architecturally correct for a joint sealing operation.

All mandatory research sections present: research_metadata, relevant_findings (10), research_corrections (2), key_decisions (12), condition_drivers (2), paintable_items (1), paintscope_key_mapping, spec_inputs (3), production_rates (3 rate tables), material_systems (4), consumables (4), protection_zones (2), exclusions (4), cross_spec_dependencies (2), sop_module_sketch (5 modules), task_sketch (10 tasks), scheduling_gates (2), movement_class_routing, open_questions (2).

12 key decisions documented covering all critical architectural choices: standalone spec (KD-001), LF UOM (KD-002), no quality tier (KD-003), sealant_type dimension (KD-004), joint_complexity dimension (KD-005), silicone exclusion (KD-006), polyurethane cure gate (KD-007), backer rod auto-add (KD-008), three-sided adhesion (KD-009), sequencing rule (KD-010), joint location categories (KD-011), no access modifier (KD-012). Each includes rationale and alternatives_considered.

2 protection zones -- minimal and appropriate for caulking. ext_ground_cover (edge_only, always active) and ext_surface_adjacent (light_mask, conditional on finished surfaces). Both have setup/teardown task pairs. materials.json protection_materials matches sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones.

No geometry computation anywhere. All geometry from estimator-captured inputs (IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL, IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD). Material quantities derived from LF/tube yield rates. No internal area/perimeter calculations.

All 3 required inputs declared with paintscope_key mappings in resolution.json, sop_modules.json required_inputs, and production.json caulk_input_group. IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL (required), IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD (optional, default 0), IN_ENUM_CAULK_SEALANT_TYPE (required, default acrylic_latex).

Two round configurations in sop_modules.json: RC_CAULK_SIMPLE (simple bead, excludes backer rod tasks) and RC_CAULK_BACKER_ROD (backer rod, excludes simple bead apply task). Both correctly list active and excluded tasks. Module sequence is identical for both -- the difference is task activation within modules. No round configurations needed in production.json per resolution.json (single-pass operation).

doctrine_checks.check: SPEC-SPECIFIC: Simple vs Backer Rod Rate Split
doctrine_checks.details: Production rates correctly differentiated: TSK_CAULK_APPLY_SIMPLE at 125 LF/hr (range 100-150), TSK_CAULK_APPLY_BACKER at 87 LF/hr (range 75-100). Matches research.json rate tables RATE_CAULK_SIMPLE_BEAD and RATE_CAULK_BACKER_ROD exactly. Rate difference (~30% slower for backer rod) is consistent with the added complexity of wider joints and precision depth control.

production.json correctly routes inputs: simple_bead tasks use IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL (with quantity_note documenting subtraction of backer_rod LF), backer_rod tasks use IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_BACKER_ROD. All non-conditional tasks use IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL. FIXED tasks reference IN_LF_CAULK_JOINT_TOTAL as context but use fixed_time_minutes for rate.

exterior_validation_summary.interior_contamination: none -- no interior keys, states, or zones found
key_architectural_departures: No quality tier dimension -- sealant_type replaces QT as cost/quality driver
No substrate state dimension -- caulk joints have no painted state concept
No application method dimension -- all caulking is gun-and-tool
No FAC_EXT_ACCESS modifier -- access shared with adjacent painting spec per KD-012
No wind or environmental factor modifiers -- caulking is not spray-sensitive
Single factor modifier (FAC_CAULK_JOINT_COMPLEXITY) uses task_selection mechanism, not rate multiplier
Standalone line item spec -- crosses all exterior surface boundaries
Sealant is the deliverable product, not paint -- material systems are sealant tubes, not primer/finish coats
Scheduling gates (polyurethane cure, after-primer sequencing) create cross-spec dependencies with 5 painting specs
exterior_validation_summary.structural_novelty_notes: This is the first non-coating spec in the exterior pipeline. It produces a sealed joint, not a painted surface. The absence of quality tier, substrate state, and application method dimensions is architecturally correct -- these dimensions are meaningless for joint sealing. The spec correctly uses sealant_type and joint_complexity as its configuration dimensions instead.

max_modifier_stack.scenario: No rate modifiers -- FAC_CAULK_JOINT_COMPLEXITY is a task_selection factor, not a rate multiplier
